Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:1.hebrew: מאי שנא נגיחה דקרי ליה אב דכתיב כי יגח נגיפה נמי כתיב כי יגוף שור איש את שור רעהו - וכיון דנגיפה כתיב, תיהוי נמי אב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:1.english: What is different about goring that [the tanna] calls it a primary category, as it is written: "If [an ox] gores," [and] negifah is also written: "If one man's ox hurts the ox of another" - And since negifah is written, let it also be a primary category.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:2.english: This striking is goring - And not pushing with the body.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:3.english: Scripture began with striking - [As in the verse:] "If one man's ox hurts the ox of another" [Exodus 21:35].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:4.hebrew: וסיים בנגיחה - או נודע כי שור נגח הוא, ולא כתיב כי שור נגף הוא, אלא נגח:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:4.english: And concluded with goring - [As the verse states:] "Or if it is known that it is a goring ox," and it is not written "that it is a striking ox," but rather "goring."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:5.hebrew: לומר לך - דהך נגיפה לאו דחיפת הגוף היא, אלא נגיחת קרן. וליכא למימר דאכתי נגיפה הוי אב, ונגיחה זו היא נגיפה, דהיינו דחיפת הגוף, דהא נגיחה אשכחן דבקרן היא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:10:5.english: To say to you - That this negifa is not shoving with the body, but rather goring with a horn. And one cannot say that negifa is still a primary category, and this goring is [actually] negifa, meaning shoving with the body, for we find that goring is with a horn.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:11:1.hebrew: גבי אדם - כשהשור נגח אדם כתיב כי יגח שור את איש, וגבי נגיחה שור בשור כתיב כי יגוף שור איש את שור רעהו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:11:1.english: Regarding a person - When an ox gored a person, it is written: "If an ox gores a man," and regarding the goring of an ox by an ox, it is written: "If one man's ox hurts the ox of another."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:12:1.english: A person, who has a mazal - That he has the understanding to protect his body.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:12:2.hebrew: כתיב כי יגח - דודאי נתכוון השור להרע ובא עליו בכח, אבל נגיפה הוי משמע שמצאו עומד ודחפו בקרניו. לישנא אחרינא: אית ליה מזלא, ואינו נוח להמיתו בנגיפה, דהיא דחיפת קרן מעט, אלא בנגיחה בכח ובכוונה, ובתחיבת קרן בגוף:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:12:2.english: It is written: "If [an ox] gores" - For certainly the ox intended to do harm and came upon him with force; but *negifah* implies that it found [the other animal] standing and pushed it with its horns. An alternative formulation: [A person] has *mazal*, and it is not easy to kill him with *negifah*, which is a slight push of the horn, but rather [only] with *negichah*, with force and with intent, and with thrusting the horn into the body.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:13:1.hebrew: ואגב אורחיה קמ"ל - קרא, מדתלה נגיחה באדם ונגיפה בבהמה — דמשמע נוחה היא הבהמה למות מן האדם — משמיענו, דשור המועד להרוג את הבהמה ג' פעמים, לא חשיב העדאה לגבי אדם; דאם נגח אדם ומת, דינו כתם, דאינו משלם את הכופר. דבתם ההורג אדם כתיב: סקול יסקל השור ובעל השור נקי (שמות כ״א:כ״ח), ובמועד כתיב: וגם בעליו יומת. וההיא מיתה היינו ממון, שמשלם את הכופר — דמי נהרג ליורשיו — ולא מיתה ממש, דאמרינן בפ"ק דסנהדרין (דף טו:): על רציחתו אתה הורגו, ואי אתה הורגו על רציחת שורו. אבל מועד לאדם הוי מועד לבהמה. ומועד להרוג את האדם משכחת לה כשלא עמד בדין עד שנגח שלש פעמים, שלא נסקל מיד כשהמית הראשון:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:13:1.english: And in passing it teaches us - Scripture, since it associated goring with a person and striking with an animal — which implies that an animal dies more easily than a person — teaches us that an ox that is forewarned to kill an animal [by having killed] three times is not considered forewarned with regard to a person; for if it gored a person and [he] died, its status is that of an innocuous [ox], in that [the owner] does not pay the ransom [kofer]. For regarding an innocuous [ox] that kills a person, it is written: "The ox shall surely be stoned, and the owner of the ox shall be clear" (Exodus 21:28), and regarding a forewarned [ox], it is written: "and its owner also shall be put to death" [Exodus 21:29]. And that "death" is monetary [compensation], in that he pays the ransom — the value of the victim to his heirs — and not actual death, as we say in the first chapter of Sanhedrin (15b): "For his [own] murder you execute him, but you do not execute him for the murder [committed by] his ox." However, [an ox that is] forewarned regarding a person is forewarned regarding an animal. And [as for an ox being] forewarned to kill a person, you find [such a case] where it did not stand trial until it had gored three times, so that it was not stoned immediately when it killed the first [one].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:15:1.english: Crouching is a secondary category of Foot - For by means of bending [its] legs, it crouches.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:15:2.hebrew: רגל הזיקה מצוי - דכל שעה היא מהלכת, ואם יש כלום תחת רגליה, היא דורסת:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:15:2.english: Foot, its damage is common - For it is constantly walking, and if there is anything under its feet, it tramples [it].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:15:3.hebrew: הני אין הזיקן מצוי - הלכך תולדה דקרן הן, דאין הזיקו מצוי, ואין הנאה להזיקו, ומשלמי חצי נזק כקרן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:15:3.english: These, their damage is not common - Therefore, they are a secondary category of Keren, for its damage is not common, and there is no pleasure from its damage, and [the owner] pays half-damages like Keren.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:17:1.hebrew: מאי שנא קרן - דמחייב, דכוונתו להזיק כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:17:1.english: What is different about Keren - That [one] is liable, for its intention is to cause damage, etc.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:19:1.english: And he sends forth - [The verse continues:] "His animal."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:1:1.hebrew: וטמא מת - מי שנגע במת הוי אב הטומאה, דמת עצמו אבי אבות הטומאה הוא, והנוגע בו הוי אב הטומאה, ומטמא אדם וכלים, דהא כתיב: כל אשר יגע בו הטמא יטמא וגו' (במדבר יט), והאי קרא בטמא מת כתיב, ומשמע דמטמא אדם, דהא כתיב: והנפש הנוגעת וגו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:1:1.english: And one who is impure with corpse-impurity - One who touched a corpse is a primary source of ritual impurity, for the corpse itself is the ultimate source of ritual impurity, and one who touches it is a primary source of ritual impurity, and renders a person and vessels impure. For it is written: "Whatever the impure [person] touches shall become impure, etc." (Numbers 19), and this verse is written regarding one who is impure with corpse-impurity, and it implies that he renders a person impure, as it is written: "and the person who touches, etc."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:2:1.hebrew: הכא מאי - תולדות דשבת הוי כאבות, תולדות דטומאה לא הוי כאבות, והכא תולדות דנזקין מאי? מי אמרינן תולדות כיוצא בהן, לא שנא אב, ל"ש תולדה, אם הזיק משלם, או דלמא לא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:2:1.english: Here, what [is the law] - The secondary categories of Shabbat are like the primary categories; the secondary categories of ritual impurity are not like the primary categories; and here, [regarding] the secondary categories of damages, what [is the law]? Do we say [that] the secondary categories are like them — [it is] no different [for] a primary category [and] no different [for] a secondary category, if it caused damage, he pays — or perhaps not?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:2:2.english: Some of them, etc. - And further on [the Gemara] explains Rav Pappa's statement in our sugya.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:4:1.english: "With these shall you gore Aram," [and] "with them he shall gore nations" - Evidently, goring is with a horn.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:5:1.english: Words of tradition - The Prophets and the Writings.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:6:1.hebrew: והאי מילף הוא - בתמיה: הא לא גמרי' מדברי קבלה לא חיוב ולא פטור, אלא גלוי מילתא הוא, דכל היכי דכתיב נגיחה בקרן הוא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:6:1.english: And is this a derivation? - [This is asked] in astonishment: Surely we do not derive from the words of tradition [either] liability or exemption, but [here] it is merely a clarification of the matter, that wherever "goring" is written, it is with a horn.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:7:1.hebrew: אלא - להכי איצטריך ואומר, דמהו דתימא: כי חלק רחמנא בין תמה למועדת — דבשור תם כתיב וחצו את כספו, דלא משלם אלא חצי נזק, ובמועד כתיב שלם ישלם שור תחת השור, דמשלם נזק שלם — ה"מ בקרן תלושה, דומיא דקרני צדקיה בן כנענה, וכגון שאחזה הבהמה הקרן בין שיניה ונגחה, דהתם ודאי לא משלם תם כוליה נזק, משום דאין דרכה בכך, ולא היה לבעלים לשמור מדבר זה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:7:1.english: Rather - For this [reason], "and it says" was necessary: lest you say that when the Merciful One distinguished between an innocuous [animal] and a forewarned [animal] — for regarding an innocuous ox it is written: "and they shall divide its money" [Exodus 21:35], that [the owner] pays only half-damages, and regarding a forewarned [ox] it is written: "he shall surely pay ox for ox" [Exodus 21:36], that [the owner] pays full damages — this applies [only] to a detached horn, similar to the horns of Zedekiah son of Chenaanah, such as where the animal held the horn between its teeth and gored [with it], for there, certainly [the owner of] an innocuous [animal] does not pay full damages, because it is not its usual manner to do so, and the owner was not [expected] to guard against this matter.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:7:2.english: But an attached [horn] - For it is its normal way.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:7:3.hebrew: אימא כולה מועדת היא - אפילו בתחילה, ומשלם נזק שלם:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:7:3.english: Say that it is entirely forewarned - Even initially, and [the owner] pays full damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:8:1.hebrew: ת"ש - וקרני ראם כתיב בה נגיחה, אלמא מחוברת נמי קרי נגיחה, ובסתם נגיחה פליג רחמנא בין קרן תמה לקרן מועדת:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:8:1.english: Come and hear - And [regarding] "the horns of a wild ox," goring is written concerning it; evidently, an attached [horn] is also called "goring," and regarding unspecified goring, the Merciful One distinguished between an innocuous horn and a forewarned horn.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:9:1.english: Pushing - That [the animal] pushed with its body and caused damage intentionally.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:9:2.hebrew: רביצה - שראתה כלים בדרך, והלכה ורבצה עליהן כדי לשברן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:9:2.english: Crouching - Where [the animal] saw vessels in the road, and went and crouched upon them in order to break them.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:9:3.hebrew: בעיטה - שבעטה ברגליה ושברה את הכלים, ואהכי הוו תולדה דקרן, דכוונתן להזיק כי קרן, ואין הנאה להזיקה כי קרן, ואין הזיקו מצוי תדיר; והלכך הוו כי קרן, דכל אימת דלא הועדה בב"ד ג' פעמים בכך, אינה משלמת נזק שלם:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 2b:9:3.english: Kicking - [A case where] it kicked with its feet and broke utensils, and this is why they are a secondary category of Keren: for their intent is to cause damage, like Keren; and there is no pleasure from its damage, like Keren; and its damage is not constantly frequent; and therefore they are like Keren, in that as long as it has not been forewarned in court three times for this, [its owner] does not pay full damage.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:13:1.hebrew: ומלתא אגב אורחיה קמ"ל - ואפילו לרב פפא, דאמר לקמן בשור שנגח ד' וה' (בבא קמא דף לז.) דמועד לאדם סתמא לא הוי מועד לבהמה, היינו דוקא שנגח ג' בני אדם, דבהכי לא הוי מועד לבהמה; אבל נגח אדם ושור וחמור, דהוי מג' מינים, הוי מועד לכל. אבל נגח שור וחמור וגמל, לא הוי מועד לאדם, ואע"ג דלכל בהמה הוי מועד אפילו לרב פפא, כדאיתא התם. וה"ר מנחם פי', דה"ק: מועד לאדם שהיה מועד לכל, וחזר בו מבהמה ונשאר מועד לאדם, הוי מועד לבהמה, דחזרה דבהמה לאו חזרה היא; אבל מועד לכל וחזרה מאדם, לא הוי מועד לאדם, דחזרה דאדם חזרה היא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:13:1.english: And it teaches us a matter in passing - And even according to Rav Pappa, who says later in "An ox that gored four and five" (Bava Kamma 37a) that [an ox that is] forewarned with regard to a person is ordinarily not forewarned with regard to an animal — that is specifically where it gored three people, for in that case it does not become forewarned with regard to an animal; but if it gored a person, an ox, and a donkey, which are of three [different] species, it is forewarned with regard to all [creatures]. But if it gored an ox, a donkey, and a camel, it is not forewarned with regard to a person, even though it is forewarned with regard to all animals, even according to Rav Pappa, as is stated there. And Rabbeinu Menachem explained that this is what [the Gemara] means: [An ox] forewarned with regard to a person that was forewarned with regard to all [creatures], and it reverted [to being innocuous] with regard to animals, but remained forewarned with regard to a person — it is [still considered] forewarned with regard to an animal, because reversion with regard to animals is not [a valid] reversion. But [an ox that was] forewarned with regard to all [creatures], and reverted with regard to a person, is not forewarned with regard to a person, because reversion with regard to a person is [a valid] reversion.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:1:1.hebrew: דאילו אב מטמא אדם וכלים - גרס, ולא גרסינן: אדם ובגדים, שלשון זה משמע: מטמא אדם לטמא בגדים. וא"ת: והרי טמא מת עושה כלי מתכת כיוצא בו, דחרב הרי הוא כחלל, אלמא יש מהן כיוצא בהן? וי"ל: דאכתי אינו עושה כיוצא בו, שאותו כלי מתכת אין עושה כלי מתכת אחר כיוצא בו, כמו שמדקדק ר"ת בריש מתני' דאהלות:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:1:1.english: For whereas a primary category defiles a person and vessels - This is the reading, and we do not read "a person and garments," for this phrasing implies [that it] defiles a person to defile garments. And if you say: But behold, one defiled by a corpse (t'mei met) makes a metal vessel like itself, for "a sword is like the slain" (cherev harei hu ke-chalal); evidently, there are some of them that are like them? And one can say: Still, it does not make [it] like itself, for that metal vessel does not make another metal vessel like itself, as Rabbeinu Tam infers at the beginning of the Mishnah of Oholot.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:20:1.hebrew: כאשר יבער הגלל - פי' ר"ח: כמו נדבכין די אבן גלל (עזרא ו׳:ד׳), שהשן דומה לאבן שייש:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:20:1.english: As one consumes the dung - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: [It is] like "courses of marble stone" (Ezra 6:4), for the tooth resembles a marble stone.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:3:1.hebrew: תנו רבנן שלשה אבות - הפסיק בברייתא זו, לפרש: תולדותיהן לאו כיוצא בהן דקאמר רב פפא, אהייא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:3:1.english: The Rabbis taught: Three primary categories - [The Gemara] interrupted with this Baraita to explain: [Regarding] "their derivatives are not like them" that Rav Pappa stated — to which [category] does it refer?

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:7:1.hebrew: אבל במחוברת אימא כולה מועדת היא - לשלם נזק שלם, אפילו בפעם ראשונה. וא"ת: ומהי תיתי? אי מתלושה - דייה כתלושה! אי משאר אבות - התינח למ"ד (לקמן בבא קמא ד' ה:): קרן עדיפא, דכוונתו להזיק, ואפילו קרן אתי, וכדמפרש ר"ת לקמן, דהיינו למ"ד: פלגא נזקא ממונא, דאית ליה: סתם שוורים לאו בחזקת שימור קיימי; אבל למ"ד: פלגא נזקא קנסא, דאית ליה: סתם שוורים בחזקת שימור קיימי, לא אתיא קרן מכולהו, כדאמרינן לקמן (שם): כי שדית בור בינייהו, אתי כולהו לבר מקרן, דאיכא למיפרך: שכן מועדין מתחילתן, פי': דרכן להזיק, משא"כ בקרן, דבחזקת שימור קיימי. וי"ל: דלמ"ד פלגא דנזקא קנסא, הא דקאמר "אבל במחוברת אימא כולה מועדת היא", וישלם נזק שלם בפעם ראשונה - לאו משום דאיצטריך קרא לאשמועינן דאין מועדת, אלא התנא הוצרך לאשמועינן, להביא ראיה מן הפסוק דמחוברת נמי הוי בכלל נגיחה, שלא תטעה לומר: דנגיחה היינו בתלושה, דומיא דקרני ברזל דצדקיה, אבל במחוברת דרכו להזיק מתחילתו, ונלמוד מבור ומחד מאבות לחייבו לכתחלה נזק שלם:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 2b:7:1.english: But with an attached [horn], say [that] it is entirely forewarned - To pay full damages, even the first time. And if you say: And from where would this be derived? If from a detached [horn] — it is sufficient for it to be like the detached [horn]! If from the other primary categories [of damage] — this works well according to the one who says (below, Bava Kamma 5b) [that] keren is superior because its intention is to cause damage, and even keren can be derived [from them]; and as Rabbeinu Tam explains below, that this is according to the one who says [that] half-damages is a monetary obligation (palga nizka mamona), who holds that ordinary oxen are not presumed to be guarded. But according to the one who says [that] half-damages is a penalty (palga nizka knasa), who holds that ordinary oxen are presumed to be guarded, keren cannot be derived from all of them, as we say below (ibid.): "When you cast pit among them, all of them can be derived except for keren," for one can refute [the derivation]: "For they are forewarned from their inception" — meaning, their way is to cause damage, which is not the case with keren, as [oxen] are presumed to be guarded. And one can say: That according to the one who says [that] half-damages is a penalty, that which [the Gemara] says, "But with an attached [horn], say [that] it is entirely forewarned," [meaning] and it should pay full damages on the first occasion, is not because a verse was needed to teach us that it is not forewarned. Rather, the Tanna needed to teach us [and] bring proof from the verse that an attached [horn] is also included in [the category of] goring (negichah), so that you should not mistakenly say that "goring" applies only to a detached [horn], similar to the iron horns of Zedekiah, whereas with an attached [horn], its way is to cause damage from its inception, and we would derive from pit and from one of the [other] primary categories to obligate [the owner] from the outset [to pay] full damages.
